source.name: MotoGP.com: Aprilia Racing and Monster Energy sign a multi-year sponsorship agreement
source.quote: the presence of the iconic, three-claw logo on the factory RS-GP bikes, on the riders’ leathers, and on the team’s key assets
source.note: The quote is the second half of the sentence 'The collaboration between Aprilia Racing and Monster Energy will be highlighted by the presence of the iconic, three-claw logo...'. Announced at the Grand Prix of Italy: Monster Energy joins as main sponsor from the 2026 Italian GP and becomes title sponsor in 2027 (CEO Massimo Rivola: 'alongside us in 2026 as main sponsor and who will take on the role of title sponsor in 2027'). Aprilia Racing raced the first part of 2026 without a title sponsor.

source.name: FES Global Group: FES continues its partnership with Aprilia Racing in 2026
source.quote: FES Global Group renews its partnership with Aprilia Racing for the 2026 MotoGP season, confirming its role as Official Sponsor of the Italian team
source.note: FES's own announcement on the renewal for 2026. The sentence continues 'competing in the MotoGP World Championship'.

source.name: Wide Magazine (Piaggio Group): Aprilia Racing and SC-Project still together for the 2026 MotoGP season
source.quote: Aprilia Racing has renewed the technical partnership with SC-Project for the 2026 MotoGP season
source.note: The same release says 'From 2022, SC-Project has been Aprilia Racing’s Exhaust Official Technical Supplier', developing exhausts for the RS-GP machines.

summary: 2026 Aprilia Racing (Marco Bezzecchi, Jorge Martín). The factory team raced the first part of the season without a title sponsor; Monster Energy joined as main sponsor from the 2026 Grand Prix of Italy (announced 29 May 2026) and becomes title sponsor in 2027. Also recorded: FES Global Group, renewed Official Sponsor for 2026 (its own announcement of 20 Jan 2026), and SC-Project, Aprilia Racing's Exhaust Official Technical Supplier, whose partnership was renewed for 2026 (Piaggio Group's Wide Magazine, 1 Oct 2025). sponsorsComplete is false: Aprilia's own partner page (aprilia.com) is built in JavaScript and blocked to scripted access, so its full partner list could not be checked.
